# Results (generated by src/analysis.py)

- CMS Provider x Drug rows read: 25,209,729
- Total Medicare Part D opioid claims (51 jurisdictions): 56.9 M
- States with CDC opioid death data for 2020: 42 of 51 (missing: AL, AR, FL, ID, LA, MN, ND, NE, PA)
- Opioid deaths in analysed states (12 months to Dec 2020): 54,781
- Model 1, death rate ~ prescribing rate: R² = 0.006, p = 0.613
- Model 2, + 5 SDOH variables (standardized): R² = 0.447 (adj. 0.352), F-test p = 0.001
- Strongest significant predictor: Uninsured %
- Kruskal-Wallis across income tertiles: H = 4.37, p = 0.112
